title: Kernel formula for finite constant quotient maps.
statement: theorem constant_quotient_kernel (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) (U : C) : RingHom.ker ((quotient J A I n).hom.app (op U)).hom = Ideal.span (Set.range (fun a : ↥(I ^ (n + 1)) ↦ (constantSection (J := J) (a : A)).val (op U)))

proof.text: Use the local zero criterion for the sheafification of the constant quotient presheaf. A section in the kernel is locally represented by elements of I^(n+1); finite generation of this ideal turns the local representations into a finite expression using constant ideal sections and arbitrary sections. Conversely, every constant section from I^(n+1) is killed by the quotient map, and the kernel is closed under ideal combinations.
